actions.name: list_calls
actions.description: List calls. List all calls and meetings within the API key's access scope. Keys with whole-company access list every call; scoped keys list only the calls they can access.

from.description: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.000Z, this filters on the call creation date in Leexi (created_at)

to.description: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.000Z, this filters on the call creation date in Leexi (created_at)

actions.name: create_call
actions.description: Create a call or meeting asynchronously (creation time is typically a few minutes). You must first finish uploading the recording of the call using a presigned recording url retrieved with the [Request a presigned url](/reference/request-a-presigned-url) endpoint. Use the [LIST users](/reference/list-users) endpoint to find the user_uuid to use in this request.

custom_fields.description: Free-form key/value pairs stored on the call and returned as-is by the [LIST calls](/reference/list-calls) and [GET call](/reference/get-call) endpoints. Only for custom integrations agreed with Leexi: the keys and their meaning must be defined with the Leexi team beforehand, otherwise the values are stored but never used. Values must be scalars (string, number, boolean or null).

customers.description: The external participants (customers) of the call. An array of objects, each accepting any of `name`, `email`, `phone_number` and `uuid` (only one attribute is required per object). When `uuid` is set it links an existing customer and the other attributes are ignored; unknown uuids are skipped. The provided names are used to help identify the speakers in the transcript. Prefer this over the deprecated `emails` and `raw_phone_number` params. ⚠️ Cannot be combined with the deprecated `emails` or `raw_phone_number` params in the same request (returns a 400).

uuid.description: uuid of an existing customer to link

emails.description: ⚠️ DEPRECATED — kept for backward compatibility only. A list of emails of other participants in the call. Use `participating_user_uuids` (for fellow Leexi users) and the `customers` array (for external participants) instead. Cannot be combined with `customers` or `participating_user_uuids` in the same request (returns a 400).

external_id.description: the id of the call in your system

locale.description: fr-FR en-US de-DE es-ES nl-NL ar-AE da-DK hi-IN id-ID it-IT ja-JP ko-KR nb-NO pl-PL pt-PT ru-RU sv-SE tr-TR uk-UA zh-CN fr-CA he-IL th-TH bg-BG cs-CZ el-GR et-EE fi-FI hr-HR hu-HU lt-LT lv-LV ro-RO vi-VN en-AU en-GB en-NZ en-IN ca-ES

participating_user_uuids.description: uuids of fellow Leexi users participating in the call (in addition to the owner set via `user_uuid`). Use the [LIST users](/reference/list-users) endpoint to find them. ⚠️ Cannot be combined with the deprecated `emails` or `raw_phone_number` params in the same request (returns a 400).

raw_phone_number.description: ⚠️ DEPRECATED — kept for backward compatibility only. A string representation of the customer's phone_number. Use the `customers` array instead (set its `phone_number` attribute). Cannot be combined with `customers` or `participating_user_uuids` in the same request (returns a 400).

recording_s3_key.description: the recording_s3_key returned by the [Request a presigned url](/reference/request-a-presigned-url) endpoint

title.description: The title of the call or meeting

user_uuid.description: The uuid of the user associated to the call, must have an active license.

actions.name: get_call
actions.description: Get call. Getting a single call or meeting. This returns the same attributes as the [LIST calls](/reference/list-calls) endpoint with additionally the call topics and the call transcript. The simple_transcript has paragraph-level timestamps, while the transcript also has word-level timestamps. The call must be within the API key's access scope, otherwise the endpoint responds with 404.

actions.name: request_presigned_url
actions.description: Request a presigned URL to upload a call recording, before creating the call. To upload the file you must send a PUT request to the returned url, with the headers provided by the endpoint (single-part upload). This uploaded file automatically expires after 3 days unless used to create a call.

actions.name: list_call_notes
actions.description: List call notes for a given call. `call_uuid` is required. You can optionally filter by `prompt_uuid`. Only call notes generated from prompts in the `summary` or `text` categories are returned. The call must be within the API key's access scope, otherwise no notes are returned.

call_uuid.description: The uuid of the call whose notes you want to list.

prompt_uuid.description: Optional prompt uuid to filter call notes to a single prompt.

actions.name: delete_call_note
actions.description: Delete a call note

actions.name: get_call_note
actions.description: Get a call note. Retrieve a single call note

actions.name: update_call_note
actions.description: Update a call note. Update a note for a given call

locale.description: The locale of the translation to update, for example `en-US`.

actions.name: list_meeting_events
actions.description: list meeting events.

from.description: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.000Z, this filters on the meetings start_time (or other date_filter)

to.description: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.000Z, this filters on the meetings start_time (or other date_filter)

actions.name: create_meeting_event
actions.description: Create a meeting event.

user_uuid.description: Leexi user associated with the meeting. (Use the LIST users endpoint)

actions.name: delete_meeting_event
actions.description: Delete a meeting event.

actions.name: get_meeting_event
actions.description: Get a meeting event.

actions.name: launch_meeting_assistant
actions.description: Launch a meeting assistant.

actions.name: list_teams
actions.description: List teams. List all teams in your workspace

actions.name: create_team
actions.description: Create a team in your workspace. The team inherits your company settings and gets the default email templates.

active.description: Defaults to `true` on creation. A team can only be deactivated once it has no active users.

name.description: The team name. It must be unique within your workspace.

actions.name: delete_team
actions.description: Delete a team. Only a team with no users and no calls can be deleted; deactivate it instead with a `PATCH` setting `active` to `false`.

actions.name: get_team
actions.description: Get a team. Retrieve a single team of your workspace.

actions.name: update_team
actions.description: Update a team. Only the attributes present in the body are updated.

active.description: Defaults to `true` on creation. A team can only be deactivated once it has no active users.

name.description: The team name. It must be unique within your workspace.

actions.name: list_users
actions.description: List Users. List all users in your workspace

actions.name: create_user
actions.description: Create a user in your workspace. The user receives a welcome email with a link to set their password, unless `send_welcome_email` is `false`.

active.description: Defaults to `true` on creation. Set to `false` to deactivate the user.

email.description: The user's email address. It must be deliverable and not already used in any Leexi company.

license.description: Either `free` or your company's own license category. Any other value is ignored.

roles.description: Role names. Defaults to `["member"]` on creation. Privileged roles (`super_admin`, `system_admin`, `billing_manager`) cannot be assigned through the API; grant them from Leexi > Settings > Users.

send_welcome_email.description: Defaults to `true`. Set to `false` to create the user without sending them the welcome email.

team_uuid.description: The uuid of the team the user belongs to.

actions.name: deactivate_user
actions.description: Deactivate a user. Users are never permanently deleted: their calls and history are kept, their sessions are revoked and they stop consuming a license. Reactivate them with a `PATCH` setting `active` to `true`.

actions.name: get_user
actions.description: Get a user. Retrieve a single user of your workspace.

actions.name: update_user
actions.description: Update a user. Only the attributes present in the body are updated.

active.description: Defaults to `true` on creation. Set to `false` to deactivate the user.

email.description: The user's email address. It must be deliverable and not already used in any Leexi company.

license.description: Either `free` or your company's own license category. Any other value is ignored.

roles.description: Role names. Defaults to `["member"]` on creation. Privileged roles (`super_admin`, `system_admin`, `billing_manager`) cannot be assigned through the API; grant them from Leexi > Settings > Users.

team_uuid.description: The uuid of the team the user belongs to.

actions.name: list_client_companies
actions.description: List client companies. List the client companies attached to your reseller account.

reseller_external_id.description: Only return the client company carrying this external id.

actions.name: create_client_company
actions.description: Create a client company attached to your reseller account. The company is created with its settings and the license you choose, and starts a Leexi trial ending at `trial_end`. Pass `admin` to create its first super admin in the same call.

admin.description: First user of the client company, created in the same call as its super admin in a team named `Default`, with the license of the company. Nothing is created when the admin is refused. The response returns the company only: read the admin with the client users endpoint. An email already used answers `409`, like a duplicate `reseller_external_id`: only the `message` tells them apart.

email.description: Email of the admin. Must be deliverable and not used by any Leexi user.

send_welcome_email.description: Whether to send the welcome email, from which the admin sets a password. Defaults to `true`.

license_category.description: License of the client company. Required on creation. `starter` caps the seats at 5.

max_seats.description: Maximum number of licensed users. Null for no limit.

company_size.description: Headcount range of the client company: `1_5` (1 to 5 employees) up to `1000_plus` (more than 1000).

hq_country.description: Country of the headquarters of the client company, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, for example `BE`.

name.description: Name of the client company. Must not contain `#` or `_`.

reseller_external_id.description: Your own reference for this client company. Must be unique among your client companies.

locale.description: Default locale of the client company, for example `en-US` or `fr-FR`.

time_zone.description: Time zone of the client company, for example `Europe/Paris`.

subscription_currency.description: Billing currency, for example `eur`. Locked while a Stripe subscription is active.

trial_end.description: End of the Leexi trial as a Unix timestamp (seconds). Required. A date in the past creates the company with an ended trial.

actions.name: update_client_company
actions.description: Update a client company attached to your reseller account. Only the attributes you send are changed. Setting `active` to `false` deactivates the company, see Deactivate a client company.

uuid.description: UUID of one of your client companies.

active.description: Set to `false` to deactivate the client company. Deactivation cancels its subscription and deactivates every user. Setting it back to `true` only reopens the company record: users and subscription are not restored.

license_category.description: License of the client company. Omit it to keep the current license. `starter` caps the seats at 5.

max_seats.description: Maximum number of licensed users. Null for no limit.

company_size.description: Headcount range of the client company: `1_5` (1 to 5 employees) up to `1000_plus` (more than 1000).

hq_country.description: Country of the headquarters of the client company, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, for example `BE`.

name.description: Name of the client company. Must not contain `#` or `_`.

reseller_external_id.description: Your own reference for this client company. Must be unique among your client companies.

locale.description: Default locale of the client company, for example `en-US` or `fr-FR`.

time_zone.description: Time zone of the client company, for example `Europe/Paris`.

subscription_currency.description: Billing currency, for example `eur`. Locked while a Stripe subscription is active.

trial_end.description: End of the Leexi trial as a Unix timestamp (seconds). A date in the past marks the trial as ended, a date in the future (re)starts it. Locked while the client has an open Stripe subscription (active, trialing, incomplete, past_due, unpaid or paused).

actions.name: deactivate_client_company
actions.description: Deactivate a client company attached to your reseller account. Its subscription is canceled, every user is deactivated and the company can no longer be used. Setting `active` back to `true` only reopens the company record: users and subscription are not restored.

uuid.description: UUID of one of your client companies.

actions.name: list_client_teams
actions.description: List client teams. List the teams of a client company.

company_uuid.description: UUID of one of your client companies.

actions.name: create_client_team
actions.description: Create a team in a client company. The team inherits the client company settings and is added to the default Meddic and SPICED scorecard templates.

company_uuid.description: UUID of one of your client companies.

active.description: Defaults to `true` on creation. A team can only be deactivated once it has no active users.

name.description: The team name. It must be unique within the client company.

actions.name: get_client_team
actions.description: Get a client team. Retrieve a single team of a client company.

company_uuid.description: UUID of one of your client companies.

actions.name: update_client_team
actions.description: Update a team of a client company. Only the attributes present in the body are updated.

company_uuid.description: UUID of one of your client companies.

active.description: Defaults to `true` on creation. A team can only be deactivated once it has no active users.

name.description: The team name. It must be unique within the client company.

actions.name: delete_client_team
actions.description: Delete a team of a client company. Only a team with no users and no calls can be deleted; deactivate it instead with a `PATCH` setting `active` to `false`.

company_uuid.description: UUID of one of your client companies.

actions.name: list_client_users
actions.description: List client users. List the users of a client company.

company_uuid.description: UUID of one of your client companies.

actions.name: create_client_user
actions.description: Create a user in a client company. When the client company has no active super admin, the new user becomes its super admin. The user receives a welcome email with a link to set their password, unless `send_welcome_email` is `false`.

company_uuid.description: UUID of one of your client companies.

active.description: Defaults to `true` on creation. Set to `false` to deactivate the user.

email.description: The user's email address. It must be deliverable and not already used in any Leexi company.

license.description: Either `free` or the client company's own license category. Any other value is ignored.

roles.description: Role names. Defaults to `["member"]` on creation. Unlike the regular endpoints, a reseller key may assign every role, `super_admin` and `system_admin` included, and advanced roles do not require the Governance add-on of the client company.

send_welcome_email.description: Defaults to `true`. Set to `false` to create the user without sending them the welcome email.

team_uuid.description: The uuid of the team the user belongs to.

actions.name: get_client_user
actions.description: Get a client user. Retrieve a single user of a client company.

company_uuid.description: UUID of one of your client companies.

actions.name: update_client_user
actions.description: Update a user of a client company. Only the attributes present in the body are updated. Unlike the regular endpoint, the email of a super admin or of a user whose company enforces SSO can be changed.

company_uuid.description: UUID of one of your client companies.

active.description: Defaults to `true` on creation. Set to `false` to deactivate the user.

email.description: The user's email address. It must be deliverable and not already used in any Leexi company.

license.description: Either `free` or the client company's own license category. Any other value is ignored.

roles.description: Role names. Defaults to `["member"]` on creation. Unlike the regular endpoints, a reseller key may assign every role, `super_admin` and `system_admin` included, and advanced roles do not require the Governance add-on of the client company.

team_uuid.description: The uuid of the team the user belongs to.

actions.name: deactivate_client_user
actions.description: Deactivate a user of a client company. Users are never permanently deleted: their calls and history are kept, their sessions are revoked and they stop consuming a license. Reactivate them with a `PATCH` setting `active` to `true`.

company_uuid.description: UUID of one of your client companies.

actions.name: start_client_subscription
actions.description: Start a client subscription. End the Leexi trial of a client company and start its paid Stripe subscription, with the plan, interval, currency and seats currently set on the company. Only available when you bill your clients yourself (independent reseller); otherwise billing goes through Leexi and the endpoint answers `422`. A client whose Stripe subscription is still open (active, trialing, incomplete, past_due, unpaid or paused) answers `409`: cancel it first. The request body is ignored.

company_uuid.description: UUID of one of your client companies.

actions.name: cancel_client_subscription
actions.description: Cancel a client subscription. Cancel the subscription of a client company. A client on a Leexi trial has its trial ended immediately; an open Stripe subscription (active, trialing, incomplete, past_due, unpaid or paused) is canceled with proration when you bill your clients yourself (independent reseller), and answers `422` when billing goes through Leexi. A client with nothing to cancel is left untouched and answers `200` with the message `No subscription to cancel`. The request body is ignored.

company_uuid.description: UUID of one of your client companies.
